r = await world.call('repo.shell', command="python -c "
from funcy import cache, memoize

print('=== M1: cache with key_func ===')
@cache(timeout=60, key_func=lambda x: x)
def f1(x):
    return x * 2
assert f1(5) == 10
print('PASSED')

print('=== M1: cache default behavior ===')
@cache(timeout=60)
def f2(x):
    return x * 2
assert f2(5) == 10
print('PASSED')

print('=== M2: cache.invalidate() ===')
calls = []
@cache(timeout=60)
def f3(x):
    calls.append(x)
    return x * 2
f3(5)
f3(10)
assert len(calls) == 2
f3.invalidate(5)
f3(5)  # Should recompute
assert len(calls) == 3  # Original 2 + recomputed
print('PASSED')

print('=== M3: cache.invalidate_all() ===')
calls.clear()
f3(5); f3(10)
f3.invalidate_all()
f3(5); f3(10)
assert len(calls) == 4  # All recomputed
print('PASSED')

print('=== M3: memoize.invalidate_all() ===')
@memoize
def f4(x):
    calls.append(x)
    return x * 2
f4(5); f4(10)
f4.invalidate_all()
f4(5); f4(10)
assert len(calls) == 4
print('PASSED')

print('=== M3: cache.skip ===')
assert hasattr(f1, 'skip')
print('PASSED')

print('=== M3: memoize.memory ===')
assert hasattr(f4, 'memory')
print('PASSED')

print('=== M3: cache.memory ===')
print('Has memory:', hasattr(f1, 'memory'))

print('ALL CHECKS PASSED')
